function: P3D-ABPPO (PPO variant) agent learns RIS phase shifts, reflection amplitudes, active-RIS ratio and MU transmit powers of a UAV-RIS relay to maximize energy efficiency under jamming (pp. 2-3).
system: 1-6 maritime users, uplink via hybrid active/passive RIS on UAV (M = 40-100 elements) to terrestrial BS, one jammer; 2 GHz, 10 MHz; antennas unstated (pp. 2, 4).
method: Penalized PPO variant P3D-ABPPO (authentic-boundary clipping plus P3D divergence penalty), actor-critic deep reinforcement learning trained in a simulated environment with Adam (pp. 3-4).
data_channel: Custom simulator: LoS/NLoS path-loss model of [5] plus small-scale fading; MUs and jammer on pre-planned trajectories; no dataset (pp. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Single simulated 800 x 800 x 100 m area; sweeps of M (40-100), K (1-6) and jamming power (0.05-0.25 W); no test on unseen conditions stated (pp. 4-5).
baselines: Learned only: PPO and A2C hybrid UAV-RIS, and the proposed method on an active-only UAV-RIS; no non-learned baseline (pp. 4-5, Figs. 2-7).
metrics: Energy efficiency (Mbps/J), average reward versus training episodes, jammer-to-signal ratio, radio link failure rate (RLF) (pp. 4-5).
q1_support: p. 2: "channel model considering both LoS and NLoS factors, which is widely applied in maritime communication scenarios [5]", plus small-scale fading. Custom simulator; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 4: "the jamming power Pj varies from 0.05 W to 0.25 W" (with M = 40 to 100 and K = 1 to 6). These are parameter sweeps of the evaluation; the paper never reports testing a trained policy on conditions unseen in training.
q3_support: p. 4: "the P3D-ABPPO approach achieves a better reward than the PPO approach and A2C approach". Figs. 3 to 7 (p. 5) compare only PPO, A2C and the proposed method with hybrid or active RIS; no non-learned method (random or fixed RIS, optimization algorithm) is compared.
q4_support: p. 3: "requires more training time to achieve ideal results" is a qualitative remark about PPO; the paper gives no complexity order, operation count, parameter count or runtime for its own method.
q5_support: p. 4: "In our simulations, we assume that the system is in the Cartesian coordinate system", a simulated environment. The paper has no code or data link, no DOI, and uses no public dataset.
notes: Area 6 chosen by the tie-break order (6 before 3): the learned power and RIS beam control acts on an aerial UAV-RIS relay link (abstract, p. 1); area 3 also fits by function. The title and index terms say anti-jamming, but the learned function is RIS configuration (phase, amplitude, active ratio) plus MU power for energy efficiency, with the jammer as interference in the SINR (eq. 3, p. 2), so it is not excluded under function; if the reviewer reads the function as anti-jamming, the decision would be exclude (function). q3 is 0 because every baseline is learned (PPO, A2C) or is the proposed method on another RIS type. The UAV position is fixed at (200, 200, 100) (p. 4) and is not learned. Table I and Figs. 1 to 7 were read from the page images.
